reuse_first_dispatch_rule: These findings are local stubs/ignored fields, not ecosystem-wide absence. Before implementing a row, trace its selected operation through the existing audited Qualia vision, Core image, shader/operator and renderer owners and their callers; reuse any suitable existing implementation, then qualify this native binding. No duplicate image math from enum-name discovery.
